Name: Ketchup and Fries
Author: bansaighdear
Description:
[size=4]Enjoy a meal of fries with a side of ketchup! Or, just the ketchup. I don't judge.

[/size]What this mod does:

- adds two new cooking recipes, which become available when befriending Gus

The ketchup recipe demands for:
﻿- 2 Tomatoes
﻿- 1 Oil
﻿- 1 Sugar
﻿- 1 Vinegar

The fries recipe calls for:
﻿- 3 Potatoes
﻿- 1 Ketchup


[size=3][u]If you encounter a bug, please file a bug report.[/u][/size]

Downloads.Description: Now with translations to german (by me) and korean, provided by @jjongleee!
